key_findings: Cleavage-resistant Mertk mice showed attenuated allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia after PNI, reduced capsaicin-evoked calcium flux in DRG neurons, less myelin damage, and fewer apoptotic/necroptotic cells.
MERTK cleavage raised IL-33, Hsp90 and IgG (injury site and DRG) and proinflammatory CD68+ macrophages; macrophage-specific Mertk deletion worsened all outcomes.
